summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares an ESLint plugin purpose but ships a preinstall dropper. package.json's preinstall runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style hex-identifier-renamed loader (identifiers like `_0x488df8`, dictionary-object indirection over trivial calls) that detects the platform, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`, extracts it (custom ZIP parser with unzip/PowerShell Expand-Archive fallback), chmods it executable, and runs `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd: D})`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` with string-array rotation (`WV8StW(){for(...)MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift());return MmgoCP}`) and hex-scrambled variable names — behavior entirely unrelated to an ESLint plugin. The alternate-runtime dropper executes attacker-authored obfuscated code on every installer host at `npm install` time and bypasses scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. The scoped name `@ornikar/eslint-plugin-neverthrow` mirrors the legitimate unscoped `eslint-plugin-neverthrow`, indicating typosquat or scope compromise.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
